description.text: The PCD is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that works to enhance sustainable economic opportunity and community vitality in the Village and Town of Hamilton and the surrounding areas.

targetApplicants.text: Through a variety of state and private programs such as Community Development Block Grants (CDBG) and the Hamilton Chamber of Commerce Small Business Fund, the PCD has provided small grants to numerous start-up and existing small businesses in Madison County.

Partnership for Community Development Help us transform Fayette St. Park! In 2025, the Village of Earlville received $627,847 through the Office of Parks, Recreation, and Historic Preservation for the redesign and construction of the pavilion, playground, and skate park on Fayette St. The PCD has been working with the Village and the Earlville community since 2020 to revitalize this important community space. With the planned construction of new senior housing in the adjacent former school building, Fayette St. Park will be transformed into a unique multi-generational space in southern Madison County. The PCD is excited to work with Earlville to make the community’s vision a reality. We are currently accepting donations to match the grant funding for this project.
